departments.name: General medicine
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of fever, cough, abdominal pain, diarrhea, stomach pain and other common internal diseases.
preparation: If you need an empty stomach examination, please go to the doctor in the morning and do not eat on the day.

departments.name: Surgical department
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of diseases that require surgical treatment, such as trauma, bleeding, and body surface lumps.
preparation: If there is traumatic bleeding, please use a clean dressing to stop the bleeding first.

departments.name: Department of orthopaedics
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of joint pain, waist and leg pain, sprains, fractures and other bone and joint diseases.
preparation: Carry past X-ray / CT image data

departments.name: Gynaecology and obstetrics department
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of gynecological and obstetric problems such as menstrual irregularities, abnormal white belt, and pregnancy health care.
preparation: Gynecological ultrasound needs to hold urine, please drink water in advance.

departments.name: Paediatrics
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of fever, cough, diarrhea, rash and other diseases in children under the age of 14.
preparation: Carry past medical records and vaccination certificates

departments.name: Department of ophthalmology
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of red eyes, eye pain, vision loss and other eye diseases.
preparation: Please do not wear contact lenses before visiting the doctor.

departments.name: Ear-nose-throat department
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of ear pain, tinnitus, nasal congestion, sore throat and other ear, nose and throat diseases.
preparation: Please don't pick your ears before seeing a doctor.

departments.name: Department of Dentistry
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases such as toothache, bleeding gums and oral ulcers.
preparation: Please brush your teeth to keep your mouth clean before visiting the doctor.

departments.name: Dermatological department
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of skin diseases such as rash, itching and eczema.
preparation: Do not apply ointment 24 hours before the appointment.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of headache, dizziness, dizziness, limb numbness and other neurological diseases.
preparation: Carry past medical records and imaging materials

departments.name: Cardiovascular Medicine
departments.description: Diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases such as panic, palpitations and elevated blood pressure.
preparation: If you need an empty stomach examination, please go to the doctor in the morning and do not eat on the day.

departments.name: Emergency Department
departments.description: Treat critically ill patients 24 hours a day.
departments.location: The first floor of the emergency building
preparation: If there is an emergency, you can go directly without an appointment.
